items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and structural correction. One square imaginative rough-painted illustration for 寻宝, connected to discovering one card.
Input 1 is a flawed NovelAI draft: keep its economical two-object idea, diagonal layout, ochre card and dark teal background, but CORRECT the map/card spatial relationship and repaint the smooth surfaces. Input 2 is 惩击: DRAWING-STYLE reference only, use its broad opaque matte strokes and grouped hard shadows; do not copy its subject or light beam.
View from above, slightly tilted. A large irregular torn folded map occupies the lower two thirds, diagonally from lower-left toward right-center. It is PAPER with three principal raised fold planes and torn irregular edges, not a fabric mat, slab or blank rectangular board. Open a deep indigo slit along its central fold: two jagged paper flaps lift apart around the opening. One single flat GOLD-OCHRE CARD is emerging from that slit, bottom quarter still tucked into/occluded by the gap, upper three quarters projecting diagonally toward the upper-right. The card and map must OVERLAP at the opening, rather than floating far apart as in the draft. The card is roughly one quarter of the frame width, a thin sharp-cornered rectangle without rounded corners, inset border, text or symbols. One short broken ochre route on the map ends at the slit; just three or four blunt paint dashes, no elaborate map features. Strongest contrast is the pale ochre card edge against the indigo slit and folded paper edge. Keep a broad quiet teal backdrop with a restrained dark-indigo color mass behind the opening. The impossible revelation of a card hidden inside the map is the visual idea; no scenery or extra props.
Paint in the grammar of Input 2: rough hand-painted concept illustration built from large connected opaque matte color masses, hard-edged shadows, a limited number of WIDE directional swipes and blunt dabs. Map folds are broad muted gray-brown planes, with one or two angular dark folds, a few broad midtone turns and quiet uninterrupted interior areas. Card has one ochre face, one restrained warm ivory edge, one gray-violet underside. No polished gold reflections. Stroke direction follows the folded paper and emerging card. Edges have handmade breaks and uneven opaque coverage, never uniform vector outlines. Keep details sparse and focused at the slit/card contact, secondary edges are economical. Do not add realistic paper grain, wood grain, fabric weave, glossy gradients, dense hatching, tiny brush textures, granular filters, repeated triangle facets, fine line networks, glow, particles, coins, chests, magnifiers or compass. No people, hands, faces or arms. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
